build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places two balls on platforms with a separator and peak structure
use_define_task_template: use the define_task_template decorator to register parameterized task variations with platform positions and peak direction
add_scene_objects: add static bars and dynamic balls to the PHYRE scene using C.add with scale and position arguments
update_task_relationships: update the task objective by setting body1 and body2 with a TOUCHING spatial relationship via C.update_task
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to SolutionTier.TWO_BALLS using C.set_meta to classify the puzzle difficulty
